description: Email sending-domain check. Use when a task needs to know whether a domain is set up to send email that inboxes accept: MX, SPF (with the 10-lookup limit), DKIM keys, DMARC policy, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI, with a 0-100 score and plain-English fixes. Cost: 1 credit per call.

dkim_selectors.description: Extra DKIM selectors to look up, on top of the common ones this service tries.

domain.description: The sending domain to check. Required unless email is sent.

email.description: An address to take the domain from. Refused if it disagrees with domain.

name: email_domain_auth
